examples.text: Die witterungsbeständigen Gartenzwerge haben den Frost gut überstanden.

glosses: Capable of resisting damage caused by the weather.
To make something resistant to damage caused by the weather.

examples.text: Six stations - Harlesden, Kensal Green, Watford High Street, South Kenton, Headstone Lane and North Wembley - have had their canopies weatherproofed and tactile paving laid on platforms.
